svg.title: Reveal or copy a password
svg.desc: A desktop action checks the login and unlocks temporarily with the Master Password if the table is locked. Core checks the read; temporary access relocks before the selected secret reaches the UI. Denied, cancelled, expired or unavailable requests stop.
